scope: The Adams Building in the Lace Market as documented by the 2008 exterior photographs. Includes the three projecting Stoney Street bays and their open forecourt, the attached rear warehouse ranges, and the independently mapped courtyard. Historic railings and front stairs are modeled where visible. Interiors and adjacent buildings are outside scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The statutory listing describes an E-plan front, Italianate central steps and gable, red brick with ashlar and slate roofs, and rear ranges with arched windows.
The college identifies its Adams campus at the old Stoney Street lace building and distinguishes 25 Stoney Street as a separate property.

next: Build the exact mapped exterior with its inner court, masonry stair and central Italianate gable, front stone dressings, and slate roof ranges.
